== Destiny number (Batch B25, held for Bill) ==
The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip [[:File:VB5-41-Jedi_Survivor.png]] (sheet copy re-made 1 April 2010) prints destiny 1. The Players Committee card image [[:File:VB5-L-jedisurvivor-pre.gif]] and the Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) print destiny 3, which the page and GEMP use. A stat-only difference; whether it is a separate version waits on a ruling. Game text: the slip prints the maintenance icons with the words “Use 1” and “Lose 1” (“End of your turn: [Use Force] Use 1 or [Lose Force] Lose 1 or [Place out of play].”); the page now shows those words. == Destiny version made (Batch B34) ==
Under Bill's ruling that stat-only changes count as versions, the destiny difference is now a version: [[Jedi Survivor (V)]] is the original (release-sheet slip, destiny 1) and [[Jedi Survivor (V) (Errata)]] is PC-E1 (destiny 3; Players Committee card image; dated by the Master List, official text as of 27 April 2013). [[Card:1250_41]] points to the (Errata) page, [[Card:1250_41o]] to the original. GEMP: original 2250_41 (destiny 1), current 1250_41 (destiny 3).
